articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in complex software engineering benchmarks, scoring over 72% on SWE-Bench Verified, and introduces a new structured chain-of-thought mode that exposes intermediate reasoning tokens to developers via the API.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which solved 88% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems in a controlled evaluation, up from the prior generation's 72%. The system combines a refined AlphaProof-style formal verification loop with large-scale language model reasoning, representing a meaningful step toward AI systems that can autonomously generate and verify novel mathematical proofs.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has started operating in select Amazon and DHL fulfillment centers for pick-and-place and inventory sorting tasks. The robots use an end-to-end vision-to-action transformer model trained on millions of hours of teleoperation data, reportedly achieving 95% grasp success rates on previously unseen objects in unstructured environments.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Autonomous Multi-Step Assembly
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion funding round at an $18 billion valuation after publicly demonstrating its Figure 03 robot performing multi-step electronic component assembly with real-time error correction. The system leverages a foundation world model that enables zero-shot transfer across different assembly tasks, reducing reprogramming time from days to minutes.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering: A New Framework for Fine-Grained AI Safety Controls
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper and developer toolkit for 'Constitutional Steering,' allowing enterprises to define domain-specific behavioral constitutions that constrain model outputs at inference time without fine-tuning. The approach uses learned activation steering vectors derived from constitutional principles, enabling per-request safety profiles that senior engineers can version-control alongside application code.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC officially commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process, with initial production allocated to NVIDIA's next-generation Blackwell Ultra AI GPUs and Apple's M6 Pro chips. The node delivers a 20% performance gain and 30% power reduction over N2, enabled by second-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources a 400B-Parameter Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Optimized for On-Device Inference
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 MoE-400B under a permissive license, a sparse mixture-of-experts model that activates only 45B parameters per token and can run on a single high-end consumer GPU with 48GB VRAM using 4-bit quantization. Benchmarks show it matches dense models twice its active parameter count on reasoning and code generation tasks, significantly lowering the hardware barrier for production LLM deployments.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in Automotive Testing
articles.summary: QuantumScape announced that its QSE-5 solid-state lithium-metal cells have surpassed 1,000 charge-discharge cycles while retaining over 90% capacity in Volkswagen's automotive qualification testing. The achievement clears a critical industry threshold for commercial EV adoption and could enable 600+ mile ranges with 15-minute fast charging, with volume production targeted for late 2027.
